purpose: Dated correction to credential_rotation.json and the S3 report. The original evidence file is left byte-identical.

processTree.note: child of the shared-session MATLAB above, therefore owned by this run's session start, not an independent user session.

effectOfSessionRestart.consequence: Any MCP client running in existing/auto mode now attaches to the session this run started. The pre-existing 11:32 MCP sessions keep running but are no longer named by the global descriptor.
effectOfSessionRestart.authorized: The user authorized session restart, credential update and certificate-trust handling for this round.

basis: The MATLAB process that minted the exposed value (pid 7008) has exited and the connector credential lives only inside that process.
sessionDetails.json no longer carries that value (SHA-256 prefix 852b6e6d... absent; replacement hash a1c4d3f5..., length 48 -> 16).
basisRemoved: Port 31519 reuse is withdrawn as supporting evidence: the new owner (pid 15392) was started by this same run, so the reuse proves nothing about the old credential.
revocationJudgementAfterCorrection.stillMissing: No positive replay test is possible. The original value was never copied by this project and is no longer readable from disk, so it could not be presented to a live server to observe a rejection.

openDecision: Pids 15392 and 42956 are owned by this run's session start but were left running because closing them terminates the live MCP session and the desktop/engine state behind it. Requires the user's explicit go-ahead.
